lexemes.definition: A device used to measure how heavy someone or something is.
lexemes.example: The weighing scale shows the weight on a digital display.

image.brief: Show a neutral digital weighing device with a clear platform and attached numerical display, large enough to identify its function without retail prices or clinical interpretation. Keep the platform unobstructed or use one plain test object for scale. Reject a ruler, balance graphic without a device, or food-only scene that changes the shared meaning.

lexemes.definition: A display that responds when someone touches its surface.
lexemes.example: Choose an option on the touchscreen.

image.brief: Show a display with a fingertip visibly selecting one large interface button and a subtle visual response at the contact point. Keep the screen and hand large, with two or three clear interface elements and no readable private data. Reject a physical keypad, noninteractive monitor, touchpad, or floating hologram. Check the interaction cue at phone size.
